children: On September 16, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq notice that it no longer complies with Listing Rule 5550(b)(1) requiring at least $2.5 million in stockholders' equity, after reporting $735,642. The company has 45 days, until November 2, 2026, to submit a compliance plan and the notice has no immediate effect on its listing; separately, Nasdaq confirmed on September 16, 2026 that the company regained compliance with Rule 5250(c)(1) following its September 14 filing.
